mapper.select:
select ei.*, (select dept_inf.NAME from dept_inf where dept_inf.id=ei.DEPT_ID) as dept, (select job_inf.NAME from job_inf where job_inf.id=ei.JOB_ID) as job from employee_inf ei
and ei.ID like concat('%', #{id}, '%')
and ei.DEPT_ID = #{deptId}
and ei.JOB_ID = #{jobId}
and ei.NAME like concat('%', #{name}, '%')
and ei.CARD_ID like concat('%', #{cardId}, '%')
and ei.ADDRESS like concat('%', #{address}, '%')
and ei.POST_CODE like concat('%', #{postCode}, '%')
and ei.TEL like concat('%', #{tel}, '%')
and ei.PHONE like concat('%', #{phone}, '%')
and ei.QQ_NUM like concat('%', #{qqNum}, '%')
and ei.EMAIL like concat('%', #{email}, '%')
and ei.SEX like concat('%', #{sex}, '%')
and ei.PARTY like concat('%', #{party}, '%')
and ei.BIRTHDAY like concat('%', #{birthday}, '%')
and ei.RACE like concat('%', #{race}, '%')
and ei.EDUCATION like concat('%', #{education}, '%')
and ei.SPECIALITY like concat('%', #{speciality}, '%')
and ei.HOBBY like concat('%', #{hobby}, '%')
and ei.REMARK like concat('%', #{remark}, '%')
and ei.CREATE_DATE like concat(#{createDate}, '%')
order by ei.CREATE_DATE desc
